description.en:
Operator Gnosis has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for coercing frailty within the enemy via manipulation of snowstorm conditions.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Supporter Operator during field operations to exercise Hexer responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
干员灵知擅长操纵风雪削弱敌人
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为辅助干员，行使削弱者职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en:
In the wake of Kjerag slowly gaining fame, so too have Kjerag's snowcaps become better and better known.
Among them, nevermelting Originium ice crystals, as a symbol of sincerity, have become even more sought after.
Such ice crystals do exist, but acquiring them is a challenge. Only at the peaks of the most dangerous summits might they possibly be found. Numerous people drawn by the allure have ultimately found themselves leaving empty-handed.
Still, not a problem for Gnosis. The Edelweisses—once generational guards of Kjerag's archives—would know the Snow Realm better than anyone.
In his eyes, the difficulty lies in the climb.
Indeed, despite spending his childhood years in Kjerag, he much prefers absorbing himself in archives. His family relocating to Victoria only saw him devote practically all his time to studies.
Thus, even after he'd followed Enciodes back to Kjerag, he never once showed any interest in taking on the mountains.
But today, he sets foot into them alone, following an ancient notebook as he ascends a remote peak. There, Originium ice crystals wait in silence for their unearthers.
As he regards them, Gnosis cannot help but reminisce.
The dream was power and prosperity for the nation of Kjerag, but the method of realizing it continually evolved as he studied in Victoria. His ultimate conclusion, he had to accept, ran counter to that future he and Enciodes had envisioned together in their youth.
Which was why, he recalls, that as they parted and made their promise, he felt an unprecedented shred of defiance—would Enciodes come to Victoria? And should he, and should the rift in their consensus be impassable, what then?
It came to be that Enciodes did arrive. Never had they clashed before, but they knew how each other's ideals had diverged in parts. Even so, with a shared dream in mind, still they firmly took each others' hands.
Amidst the Snowcap Incident, he thought to play him at his own game, to employ more radical methods to corner Enciodes.
Thought, assessment, hesitance, and thought again. In a desolate corner, idea upon idea spun through his mind. He could do it himself, he thought. In the end, he did nothing.
When in that room they put hand in hand once again, he knew his choice had been foregone.
It seems Enciodes has conveyed the Doctor an ice crystal. Gnosis has decided to procure one too, but does not plan to gift it to anyone.
With the Snowcap Incident behind them, on this day as banal as any other, he treads alone into the mountains for one thing only—he wants to forge this ice crystal into a sword. A gift for himself.
The blade it creates would be useless in combat. Should he ever replace his weaponry, it'll need to be made separately. But that is of no consequence, for he has no plans to fight with this blade. No, it won't even see the light of day. It'll remain hidden, forever.
The crystal symbolizes unwavering loyalty. Never has he shown such a thing to Enciodes, and never will he. He will be faithful only to his own choices.
And his choice is—
The comms terminal at his belt vibrates. A communications network has been erected across the whole of Kjerag by now. Even upon the snowcaps, one can receive dispatches.
'You have a meeting.'
'Understood.'
Carefully, he chisels off an Originium ice crystal and stows it away, before heading back down the mountain.
Being the CTO of Karlan Trade, his free time is few and far between.
description.zh:
随着谢拉格的名声逐渐传开，谢拉格的雪山也逐渐为人所知。
其中，永远不会融化的源石冰晶，作为一种诚挚的象征更是成了一些人的追捧对象。
这种源石冰晶确实存在，但是想要获取却十分困难。在那些最险的山峰顶端，或许才有可能找到一些。许多慕名而来的人，最终也只能铩羽而归。
而这难不倒诺希斯，对于曾经世代守护谢拉格卷宗的埃德怀斯家来说，他们比任何人都了解这座雪境。
对他而言，难点反而在于攀登。
是的，即使是在谢拉格成长的幼年时期，他也更喜欢投身于卷宗之间。在举家迁往维多利亚后，他更是将几乎所有的时间都投入到了学习之中。
因此，即使在随着恩希欧迪斯返回谢拉格后，他也从未对挑战雪山表露出过一点兴趣。
而这一天，他却独自踏入雪山，循着一本古老的手记，攀登上了一座偏僻的山峰，在那里，源石冰晶安静地等待着来人的发掘。
看着源石冰晶，诺希斯不禁回想起过去。
将谢拉格变成一个强盛的国家，这个梦想的实现方式，随着他在维多利亚学习的推进而不断发生变化。最终他不得不承认，他得出的结论，与年幼时与恩希欧迪斯共同展望的未来背道而驰。
这让他想到离别时的那个约定时甚至有了一丝抗拒——恩希欧迪斯会来维多利亚吗？如果他来了，他们无法达成共识该怎么办？
最终，恩希欧迪斯来了。他们之间并没有产生冲突，但是他们知道彼此的理念已经有所分歧，只是，为了同一个梦想，他们依然握住了彼此的手。
雪山事变中，他有想过将计就计，用一些更激进的方法逼迫恩希欧迪斯。
思考，判断，犹豫，思考。在无人的角落，一个又一个的念头在他的胸中盘旋，他以为自己会去做，但最后，他还是没有出手。
在那间房间里再次握手的那一刻，他已经知道了自己的选择。
恩希欧迪斯似乎送了博士一块冰晶，他决定也准备一块，但他不打算送给任何人。
他在雪山事变结束后，毫无特殊意义的这一日，孤身踏入雪山只为了一件事——他要将这块冰晶打造成一柄剑送给自己。
冰晶做成的剑无法用于战斗，如果他打算更换武器，需要另行制造，但是没有关系，他也并不打算用这把剑战斗，这把剑甚至会被藏起来，永远不见天日。
冰晶象征着不变的忠诚，他过去从未对恩希欧迪斯表示过忠诚，将来也不会，他只会对自己的选择忠诚。
而他的选择——
腰间的通讯终端发出振动，通讯网络已经在谢拉格全域架设，即使身处雪山也可以接收通讯。
“该开会了。”
“我知道。”
将源石冰晶小心地敲下并收好后，他转身向着山下走去。
他是喀兰贸易的首席技术执行官，空闲时间可不多。

description.en: [Classified] Site Selection for Project One Site: Bottom of Lake Silberneherze A comprehensive geological survey of Lake Silberneherze confirms that the lakebed sediment is of ideal composition for constructing an underground base. Attached: Lake Silberneherze Lakebed Survey Report The difficulty lies in setting up a diversionary project on the island in the middle of the lake. Recently, the Vine-Bead Court proposed building a statue of Kjeragandr atop Mount Karlan. If they can be convinced to change the location, I believe it would be the best form of camouflage for Project One. Discussion: Enciodes: Kjerag is still built on a foundation of faith. If the people and the Court were to discover you using it as a pretense, there will be grave consequences. Gnosis: Overthrowing the faith was our previous plan. This time, we are simply asking it to serve as our shield, nothing more. Besides, it's completely feasible if we have enough materials to build the statue, isn't it? Enciodes: You take faith far too lightly, Gnosis. Gnosis: Don't forget that all those ancient tomes you've read about Kjeragandr account for barely a tenth of the ones I've pored over. Since I could figure out plans to handle the aftermath when we were planning on overthrowing the Court, of course I can do it again, and it'll even be easier. Enciodes: I did not mean to question the Edelweiss family's knowledge of Kjerag's history. That said, how do you plan on convincing the Saintess? Gnosis: Do we need to convince her? We simply let her know after the proverbial ball has started rolling, forcing her to agree. Don't tell me you haven't thought of that already. You're simply feeling apologetic over having to hide the truth from her, so you're trying to give her some breathing room. Gnosis: The problem is that Project One is more than just a Karlan Trade affair now. It concerns the future of all of Kjerag. When you're gambling with such high stakes, there's no room for such sentimentality. What, have you only just realized that your little sister has grown to be your equal? Are you finally wanting to play the role of good brother? Operation log: [Enciodes] resolved the discussion: [Kjerag is still built on...] Discussion: Gnosis: Rather than worrying about the Saintess, what you should really be worried about is if the future you're building is the future Kjerag wants. Enciodes: You're still brooding over this. Gnosis: I've been against the project the entire time. Gnosis: You've been playing too many political games, Enciodes. Made dealings with too many people. To you, power is making this tiny land stand among the great powers as it holds the reins of a new era, making it something no nation would dare ignore. Enciodes: And to you, power is mastery over the foundational sciences, never allowing other nations to ignore Kjerag when it comes to certain fields. Gnosis: The situation is different from what it was three years ago. Even if Caster is watching us closely, we still have time. Gnosis: Building this project and keeping it hidden will take time and energy, time I could have used to advancing Kjerag's technological base by leaps and bounds. But instead, you spent a fortune just to get a weapon you can only build according to the blueprints you bought, one you may never get to fire. Enciodes: Yet you still followed along with it, didn't you? I've already discussed this with Ratatos. You may withdraw from Project One whenever you please. If so, she will take over its construction. Enciodes: As I once said, Gnosis, I'll make Kjerag big enough for you. A grand stage where you can bring all your wit and wisdom to bear. And a grand stage means it has room for all sorts of dreams. Gnosis: All I can say is that I hope you're right. Enciodes: Ah, right, word has come from Columbia. Rhine Lab is very interested in your proposal. Gnosis: You're bringing that up now on purpose, aren't you? Enciodes: Then I suppose you will join the private conversations with Columbia? Gnosis: Yes, I will.
description.zh:
【机密文档】
《一号项目选址方案》
选址：银心湖底
经过对银心湖底的全面地质勘测，现在可以确认，湖底土质具备极为理想的结构条件，适合进行地下基地的建设。
附件：《银心湖湖底土质考察报告》
难点在于需要在湖心岛上设立作为掩护的工程项目。
前段时间，蔓珠院提出过想要在圣山周围的山上建造耶拉冈德像，只要说服他们将耶拉冈德像的建造地点改成湖心岛，那么，信仰将是一号项目最好的迷彩。
评论：
恩希欧迪斯：如今的谢拉格依然以信仰为根基，民众和蔓珠院一旦发现你以信仰为幌子，后果不堪设想。
诺希斯：上一次，我们打算推翻信仰，而这一次，只是请信仰为我们做些掩护而已。况且，若是材料足够，耶拉冈德像也完全可以造出来，不是吗？
恩希欧迪斯：诺希斯，你还是太轻视信仰了。
诺希斯：恩希欧迪斯，别忘了，你读过的和耶拉冈德有关的典籍恐怕不及我的十分之一。当时打算彻底推翻蔓珠院，我都有办法善后，现在只是打个掩护而已，方法数不胜数。
恩希欧迪斯：我并不是质疑埃德怀斯家对谢拉格历史的了解。那么，你打算怎么说服圣女？
诺希斯：我们需要说服她吗？在木已成舟之后再让她知道，逼她默许，别告诉我你没想过。你只是对隐瞒她有歉意，所以你想为她的立场留些余地。
诺希斯：但是，一号项目已经不只是喀兰贸易的事了，事关整个谢拉格的未来。既然你已经打算赌上整个谢拉格的未来，那么这种余地就不应该存在。怎么？现在你终于意识到你的妹妹已经足以和你平起平坐了，开始想当一个好兄长了？
操作记录：
【恩希欧迪斯】解决了评论【如今的谢拉格依然……】
评论：
诺希斯：比起圣女，你更应该担心的是，这一次，你换来的未来是不是谢拉格想要的未来。
恩希欧迪斯：你还在为这件事耿耿于怀。
诺希斯：我的确从头到尾都反对这个项目。
诺希斯：恩希欧迪斯，你学了太多的权术，和太多人打交道。你眼中的强大，是以弹丸之地和各大国周旋，最后紧握时代的缰绳，成为每个国家不敢忽视的存在。
恩希欧迪斯：而你眼中的强大，是掌握最核心的科技，让其他国家在某些领域永远无法忽视谢拉格的存在。
诺希斯：现在不是三年前，即使开斯特在盯着我们，我们依然还有时间。
诺希斯：建造这个项目，以及掩藏这个项目需要花费的时间和精力，足够让我再把谢拉格的科技向前推进一大步。而你花费了这么多，却仅仅是为了得到一个只需要按照买来的设计图去建造的，或许永远也不会开火的武器。
恩希欧迪斯：但你依然做了这份方案，不是吗？我已经和菈塔托丝谈过了，你随时可以从项目中抽身，她会接手一号项目的建造。
恩希欧迪斯：诺希斯，我说过，我会把谢拉格变成一个足够大，能够让你施展拳脚的舞台。而足够大的舞台就意味着，它能容纳各种各样的梦想。
诺希斯：我只能说，但愿如此。
恩希欧迪斯：对了，哥伦比亚那边的消息回来了，莱茵生命对你的提议很感兴趣。
诺希斯：你是故意在这个时候说的吧？
恩希欧迪斯：那么，哥伦比亚的秘密会谈你打算去吗？
诺希斯：去。
